faq.domanda: Do you deliver custom apparel in Lugano?
faq.risposta: Yes. We work from Sementina and serve the whole of Lugano and the rest of Ticino, whether it is a shop in the centre, an office in an outlying district or a venue in one of the neighbouring towns. We agree on how to deliver your order together right at the quote stage, based on where you are and your schedule.

faq.domanda: What are the advantages of DTF printing for apparel?
faq.risposta: The DTF (Direct to Film) technique lets us print high-resolution images directly onto the fabric, with vivid colours and excellent durability over time. It is ideal for t-shirts and promotional garments, withstands frequent washing and keeps its colours bright even after many uses, an important factor for anyone working with the public every day.

faq.domanda: When is embroidery the right choice?
faq.risposta: Embroidery is the most elegant and long-lasting option, particularly suited to company uniforms, shirts and outerwear. It works well on heavy fabrics such as hoodies and caps and gives a refined, professional look, perfect for banks, firms and service businesses throughout Lugano where your image needs to convey reliability.

faq.domanda: How much does it cost to personalise apparel in Lugano?
faq.risposta: The cost depends on the technique you choose (DTF, heat transfers or embroidery), the complexity of the graphics and the number of garments. We do not charge different rates for Lugano compared to the rest of Ticino: we prepare a clear, tailored quote based on your project, with no hidden costs.

faq.domanda: Can I order just one garment, or is there a minimum quantity?
faq.risposta: Yes, we make even a single garment, with no mandatory minimum quantities. It is the ideal solution for a shop that wants one polo for the owner, or for a professional who wishes to try out personalisation before placing a larger order for the whole team.

faq.domanda: How long does it take to complete an order?
faq.risposta: For small orders it usually takes just a few working days. For larger volumes or complex graphics the timeframe may be longer: we give you a precise estimate right at the quote stage, so you can plan openings, events or seasonal campaigns well in advance.

faq.domanda: What types of garments can I personalise?
faq.risposta: We personalise t-shirts, polos, hoodies, jackets, shirts, caps and workwear. For a restaurant we can take care of staff aprons and polos, for an office shirts and outerwear with discreet embroidery, for a shop t-shirts and hoodies coordinated with your signage, wherever you are in Lugano and Ticino.

faq.domanda: Which techniques stand up best to frequent washing?
faq.risposta: Embroidery is the most durable option, perfect for uniforms worn every day. DTF printing also offers excellent resistance if the garments are washed following the instructions. For workwear we recommend the technique best suited to how the garment is actually used and how often it is washed.
